notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 73,500.00 under work order WO/1A/096/26. Received to date QAR 37,725.00 — the 35% advance of QAR 25,725.00 on 01-10-2026 under RCT-274/2026, and QAR 12,000.00 by this receipt. BALANCE OUTSTANDING QAR 35,775.00.

HOW THIS PAYMENT IS APPLIED. The sum of QAR 12,000.00 is applied to the oldest invoice, INV-275/2026 of 02-10-2026 for QAR 29,400.00, being the 40% stage on delivery of panels, which was raised against our delivery note DN-253/2026. That invoice therefore stands at QAR 17,400.00. Our final invoice INV-300/2026 of QAR 18,375.00 remains due in full.

THE CONTRACT IS INVOICED IN FULL AND NO FURTHER INVOICE WILL FOLLOW. Settlement of the QAR 35,775.00 shown above closes the account between us — QAR 17,400.00 on INV-275/2026 and QAR 18,375.00 on INV-300/2026. Kindly quote both invoice numbers and your work order WO/1A/096/26 as the references on the remittance.

Received with thanks, and our thanks for this payment on account. We should be grateful if you would now arrange the balance, and we remain ready to attend your office to go through the account with you at any time convenient to yourselves.

WARRANTY: twelve (12) months on the cold room panels, the doors and our workmanship from the date of handover, and twelve (12) months on the compressors, coils, electrical components and controls from the date of commissioning. Excludes damage from misuse, power surge, improper voltage, water ingress, unauthorised modification or the absence of routine maintenance.
This receipt is issued against INV-275/2026 and is subject to the terms of work order WO/1A/096/26.
